title_sq: VILE TE LEMON'S RESIDENCE - LIQENI I THATE!
description_sq:
Vilë te Lemon's Residence - Liqeni i Thatë, për shitje!
Lemon’s Residence është një nga projektet më të reja dhe më cilësore në zonën e Liqenit të Thatë, e konceptuar si një komunitet i qetë, elegant dhe i mirëorganizuar, që kombinon arkitekturën moderne me relaksin natyror të zonës. Me një pozicion të privilegjuar, pranë liqenit dhe gjelbërimit, rezidenca ofron standard të lartë jetese dhe privatësi maksimale.
Në këtë rezidencë, ofrojmë për shitje një vilë 2-katëshe dhe 1 kat nëntokë. Kjo është një pronë moderne e konceptuar me standarde të larta ndërtimi dhe komoditeti, e ndërtuar në disa nivele funksionale dhe e rrethuar nga një parcelë e gjerë dhe e sistemuar. Me një organizim të balancuar të brendshëm dhe ambient të jashtëm të bollshëm, kjo vilë është zgjidhja ideale për familje që kërkojnë privatësi, hapësirë dhe cilësi.

title_en: VILE TO LEMON'S RESIDENCE - DRY LAKE!
description_en: Villa at Lemon's Residence - Dry Lake, for sale! Lemon's Residence is one of the newest and best quality projects in the Dry Lake area, conceived as a quiet, elegant and well-organized community that combines modern architecture with the natural relaxation of the area. With a privileged position, near the lake and greenery, the residence offers a high standard of living and maximum privacy. In this residence, we offer for sale a 2-storey villa and 1 basement floor. This is a modern property conceived with high standards of construction and comfort, built on several functional levels and surrounded by a spacious and orderly plot. With a balanced interior arrangement and ample outdoor space, this villa is the ideal solution for families looking for privacy, space and quality. 📐 Dimensions and Organization • Total plot area: 262.9 m² • Yard area: 232.6 m² Total building area (above and below ground): 240.5 m² Floor -1 (Underground) – 60.3 m² - Warehouse / Canteen - Ideal space for auxiliary organizations, storage or alternative uses - Laundry Floor 0 (Ground) – 86.1 m² - Spacious living room with sitting area - Functional kitchen - Dedicated dining area - Toilets - Direct access to the veranda and courtyard Floor +1 – 67.1 m² - 3 well-organized bedrooms - 2 toilets on the floor - Balcony / veranda 12.9 m² - Usable spaces and natural lighting - Staircase exit: 14.1 m² 🌿 Outdoor spaces - Arranged yard with ample area - Possibility of organization for greenery, barbeque area or relaxation corner - Privacy guaranteed thanks to the configuration of the plot ⭐ Property characteristics - Functional layout and thought for comfort - Natural lighting in all rooms - Quality structure and modern architecture 🎯 This villa is the ideal choice - Combines interior spaces with a spacious yard, perfect for families - Construction with good standards and practical organization on every level - Quiet location, suitable for long-term living - Flexibility for additional functions thanks to the auxiliary floors The villa is in the final stages of construction and will be ready for occupancy in a few weeks!!! For more information or a visit to the property, please contact us!
